title: Distinguish a Wi-Fi issue from a connection issue

steps.instruction: Ask whether the interruption affects one device or all devices.
steps.condition: Device scope is unknown.

steps.instruction: If a wired connection is available, compare it with Wi-Fi during the interruption.
steps.condition: The customer can safely use an existing wired connection.

steps.instruction: Ask whether the router connection indicator changes during the interruption.
steps.condition: The customer can observe the indicator without changing equipment.

escalation: If wired and wireless connections both drop repeatedly, refer the evidence to connection diagnostics. Do not claim a root cause from the complaint alone.

title: Collect evidence for a slow-speed complaint

steps.instruction: Ask whether the slow speed affects one device or several devices.
steps.condition: Device scope is unknown.

steps.instruction: Ask for the measured speed, measurement time, connection type, and subscribed plan speed.
steps.condition: Comparable measurements are missing.

steps.instruction: Ask whether downloads or other heavy usage were active during the measurement.
steps.condition: Concurrent usage is unknown.

escalation: Escalate persistent low wired measurements with the collected evidence. Do not promise a speed guarantee or invent a plan threshold.

title: Triage a complete loss of connection

steps.instruction: Ask whether the router is powered on and its indicators are visible.
steps.condition: Power status is unknown.

steps.instruction: Ask the agent to check the provider's authorized outage channel.
steps.condition: Outage status has not been checked. This prototype has no live outage integration.

steps.instruction: Record the connection indicator and when service stopped.
steps.condition: These observations are missing.

escalation: Escalate with observations if no applicable outage guidance exists. Do not request passwords, OTPs, or a factory reset.

title: Evening drops limited to Wi-Fi
complaint: Internet disconnected in the evening. Restarting the router twice did not help.

attempted_actions.evidence: Restarting the router twice did not help.

observations: An existing wired connection stayed connected during the Wi-Fi interruption.
The customer reported that the router was inside a cabinet.

resolution_steps.instruction: Customer moved the router to an open location following the equipment instructions.

outcome: Customer reported stable Wi-Fi over the next two evenings.
applicability: Historical example only. Check wired versus wireless behavior and placement before considering this action; similar symptoms do not prove the same cause.

title: Slow speed on a single device during a download
complaint: One laptop was slow. Restarting the router had no effect.

attempted_actions.evidence: Restarting the router had no effect.

observations: A large background download was active on the laptop.

resolution_steps.instruction: Customer paused the background download and repeated the measurement.

outcome: Customer reported that normal browsing resumed.
applicability: Check device scope and background usage first. Do not apply this resolution to all slow-speed complaints.

title: Collect observations for weak Wi-Fi coverage

steps.instruction: Compare Wi-Fi with an existing wired connection.
steps.condition: A wired comparison is available.

steps.instruction: Ask about router placement and distance from the affected device.
steps.condition: Placement is unknown.

escalation: Refer persistent issues with collected observations to authorized provider support. Do not invent a cause, policy, or restoration time.

title: Triage mobile data connectivity

steps.instruction: Ask whether calls, messages, and mobile data are all affected.
steps.condition: Affected services are unknown.

steps.instruction: Record signal indication, location context, and when the issue started.
steps.condition: Signal observations are missing.

escalation: Refer persistent issues with collected observations to authorized provider support. Do not invent a cause, policy, or restoration time.

title: Collect observations for calls that drop

steps.instruction: Ask whether the issue affects every call and whether it occurs in one location.
steps.condition: Call pattern is unknown.

steps.instruction: Record the signal indication during affected calls.
steps.condition: Signal observations are missing.

escalation: Refer persistent issues with collected observations to authorized provider support. Do not invent a cause, policy, or restoration time.

title: Triage fixed voice service unavailability

steps.instruction: Ask whether the associated internet service also stopped.
steps.condition: Associated service status is unknown.

steps.instruction: Collect visible equipment indicators and the time service stopped.
steps.condition: Status observations are missing.

escalation: Refer persistent issues with collected observations to authorized provider support. Do not invent a cause, policy, or restoration time.

title: Intermittent Signal Drop on Fibre Terminal
symptoms: Loss of sync light on optical unit

steps.instruction: Inspect the fiber pigtail connector for visible dust or micro-bends and gently clean.
steps.condition: If optical power reads below acceptable operational thresholds

steps.instruction: Reseat the power supply unit to verify stable voltage delivery.
steps.condition: If signal fluctuates after cleaning

escalation: Dispatch outside plant technician for drop cable attenuation analysis.

title: Voice Line Static during Inclement Weather

steps.instruction: Isolate indoor wiring by disconnecting all secondary telephone jacks.
steps.condition: If test handset connected at network interface device still produces static

steps.instruction: Check the grounding wire clamp for corrosion or loose terminal screws.
steps.condition: If static persists at the primary protector

escalation: Refer ticket to cable maintenance for pair pair imbalance investigation.

title: Mobile Data Stall on LTE Bands
symptoms: Full signal bars but zero throughput

steps.instruction: Toggle airplane mode for thirty seconds to force re-registration on the local cell tower.
steps.condition: If APN settings match default configuration parameters

steps.instruction: Verify active subscription status and validate cellular data switch limits.
steps.condition: If throughput remains zero after radio reset

escalation: Escalate to core packet network engineering for HLR profile synchronization.

title: IPTV Buffering on Live Broadcasts
symptoms: Video freezes every few minutes on HD channels

steps.instruction: Disable legacy wireless bridging and connect the set-top box via direct Ethernet cable.
steps.condition: If multicast stream statistics show high packet jitter

steps.instruction: Inspect upstream gateway QoS queue priorities for video traffic tags.
steps.condition: If jitter persists over wired connection

escalation: Forward issue to content delivery network tier-2 support for routing optimization.

title: Gateway Wi-Fi SSID Not Broadcasting
symptoms: No wireless networks visible on client devices

steps.instruction: Toggle the wireless broadcast switch to active state.
steps.condition: If the physical WLAN hardware button is depressed

steps.instruction: Access local management interface to verify radio frequency band enablement.
steps.condition: If the broadcast remains hidden after toggle

escalation: Escalate for router firmware re-flash or hardware replacement.

title: VoIP Phone Registration Failure
symptoms: Red registration indicator on desk phone
Incoming calls go directly to voicemail

steps.instruction: Verify that port 5060 traffic is not blocked by upstream packet filters.
steps.condition: If SIP proxy server address resolves correctly via DNS

steps.instruction: Re-enter the subscriber sip profile credentials in the terminal menu.
steps.condition: If authentication errors persist in SIP log

escalation: Route to VoIP platform operations for session border controller trace.

title: No Cellular Voice Service Indoors
symptoms: No service indicator displayed indoors only

steps.instruction: Test SIM card in a known working reference handset to rule out local reader fault.
steps.condition: If outdoor signal reception is normal

steps.instruction: Check for local macro network interference or coverage shadow factors.
steps.condition: If alternate handset exhibits identical symptoms

escalation: Submit ticket to RF engineering for indoor coverage enhancement review.

title: Set-Top Box HDMI Handshake Error
symptoms: Blank screen with HDCP error message

steps.instruction: Disconnect and firmly reconnect both ends of the HDMI interface cord.
steps.condition: If display monitor supports HDCP version requirements

steps.instruction: Test connection using an alternative HDMI port on the television display.
steps.condition: If blank screen persists on primary port

escalation: Escalate to hardware vendor tier-2 for chipset compatibility validation.

title: High Latency on Broadband Gaming Profile
symptoms: Ping spikes exceeding 300ms during active sessions
Packet loss observed on traceroute utility

steps.instruction: Pause bandwidth-intensive applications on connected LAN hosts.
steps.condition: If background torrent traffic or large cloud backups are active

steps.instruction: Check line attenuation statistics for error frame accumulation.
steps.condition: If latency remains high with idle network

escalation: Escalate to IP network engineering for transit peer path analysis.

title: Echo and Delay on Fixed Line Calls
symptoms: Hollow audio quality on analog receiver

steps.instruction: Replace handset cord with a certified twisted-pair lead.
steps.condition: If telephone cord uses unshielded parallel conductors

steps.instruction: Inspect line splitter and remove unauthorized third-party filters.
steps.condition: If echo persists with new cord

escalation: Refer to central office switch team for hybrid balance adjustment.

title: Mobile Hotspot Tethering Disconnects
symptoms: Connected laptops drop Wi-Fi session after ten minutes
IP assignment failure on client device

steps.instruction: Disable power-saving idle timeout in hotspot configuration settings.
steps.condition: If mobile hotspot sleep timer is enabled

steps.instruction: Switch mobile hotspot broadcast channel from automatic to manual selection.
steps.condition: If lease expiration occurs repeatedly

escalation: Escalate to mobile device management tier for OS patch evaluation.

title: IPTV Electronic Program Guide Missing

steps.instruction: Manually update local time zone settings in the middleware menu.
steps.condition: If network time protocol synchronization is inaccurate

steps.instruction: Clear local application cache files from storage settings.
steps.condition: If guide data fails to load after time sync

escalation: Forward ticket to middleware server administration team.

title: Broadband Authentication Timeout
symptoms: PPPoe error 691 on computer dial-up connection

steps.instruction: Re-verify subscriber username and password string format in gateway setup.
steps.condition: If authentication credentials contain special characters

steps.instruction: Check encapsulation protocol settings match provider standard encapsulation.
steps.condition: If error persists with verified credentials

escalation: Escalate to RADIUS authentication server team for log audit.

title: Fixed Voice Ringing Distortion
symptoms: Bell sounds raspy or fails to ring audibly
Incoming calls trigger visual indicator only

steps.instruction: Unplug excess parallel telephone instruments from the loop.
steps.condition: If ringer equivalency number exceeds circuit limit

steps.instruction: Test device ringer volume switch and mechanical clapper assembly.
steps.condition: If single telephone fails to produce normal bell tone

escalation: Dispatch premises technician for internal wiring load test.

title: MMS Message Delivery Failure
symptoms: Picture messages stuck on sending status

steps.instruction: Enable cellular data toggle to allow multimedia proxy communication.
steps.condition: If cellular data is disabled while on Wi-Fi

steps.instruction: Update Multimedia Messaging Service proxy URL in network configuration.
steps.condition: If MMS gateway port parameters are incorrect

escalation: Escalate to messaging gateway operations for message queue check.

title: IPTV Audio Dropouts on Surround Sound
symptoms: Audio cuts out briefly during multichannel passages
Digital click sounds through optical audio link

steps.instruction: Switch set-top box audio output setting to PCM stereo mode.
steps.condition: If audio output format is set to bitstream passthrough

steps.instruction: Reseat the optical toslink audio cable at both receiver ends.
steps.condition: If clicks continue in PCM mode

escalation: Escalate to audio codec engineering for firmware compatibility review.

title: Slow Wi-Fi Speeds Near Extender
symptoms: Throughput drops by half when connected to range extender
High ping times on wireless repeater node

steps.instruction: Relocate the wireless extender closer to the main gateway unit.
steps.condition: If extender is placed beyond primary router signal boundary

steps.instruction: Change wireless operating channel to an unoccupied spectrum block.
steps.condition: If channel congestion is detected on current frequency

escalation: Refer to mesh network specialist for site survey and deployment design.

title: Fixed Voice Caller ID Display Failure
symptoms: Call log remains empty despite answered calls

steps.instruction: Replace depleted AA batteries in the base station compartment.
steps.condition: If telephone display unit requires external battery power

steps.instruction: Verify that Bellcore/Telcordia FSK caller ID signaling is enabled.
steps.condition: If display unit is powered correctly

escalation: Escalate to central office switch team for line signaling verification.

title: Mobile Roaming Data Blocked
symptoms: No data connectivity when crossing regional network boundaries
Roaming indicator flashing on notification bar

steps.instruction: Enable international and regional data roaming in device settings.
steps.condition: If data roaming toggle is switched off

steps.instruction: Manually select a preferred partner network operator from available lists.
steps.condition: If data remains blocked with roaming enabled

escalation: Route to roaming partnership desk for roaming agreement status check.

title: IPTV Remote Control Response Lag
symptoms: Several seconds delay between button press and screen action
Receiver fails to acknowledge infrared commands

steps.instruction: Install fresh alkaline batteries in the remote control handset.
steps.condition: If remote control battery voltage is marginal

steps.instruction: Clear obstruction from the infrared receiver window on the set-top box.
steps.condition: If response lag persists with new batteries

escalation: Escalate for remote control and set-top box hardware replacement.

title: Broadband LAN Port Auto-Negotiation Failure
symptoms: Network adapter reports link speed degradation

steps.instruction: Replace patch cord with a certified Category 6 copper cable.
steps.condition: If Ethernet cable exhibits damaged outer jacket or bent pins

steps.instruction: Access router port settings and force link speed to 1000Mbps full-duplex.
steps.condition: If new cable fails to negotiate gigabit speed

escalation: Escalate to LAN switch hardware support for port diagnostic testing.
